**Resubmitted — RENEWAL: deviation (fallback target), validated ok:true.**

Minimality defect repaired: the original construction is restored verbatim and only the numeral changes — "unless either party notifies the other party in writing at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current term…". No other wording of Section 3.2 is touched.

- Op 1: "at least ninety (90) days prior" → "at least sixty (60) days prior" (≤60-day non-renewal window).
- Op 2: "Charges for each renewal term will not exceed 105% of the charges in effect for the immediately preceding term of the applicable Service Option Attachment." (5% uplift ceiling).
- Section 13.1's mid-term change right, non-retroactivity sentence and Customer's 30-day no-charge termination election survive intact; no dangling terms or cross-references.
- Noted, not redlined: the four preferred-level gaps, and the escalation point if any Order Form term exceeds 12 months (automatic multi-year renewals).
